endpoints.name: Create Visit

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; repeating the call may perform the action again

endpoints.detailed_description: Create visit. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IVisit.GetVisitActivityTypeByIdAsync, IVisit.GetVisitDealerByIdAsync. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid Visit Activity Type ID [when activityType == null]; Invalid Dealer ID [when dealer == null]; Invalid Project ID [when project == null]; Invalid Client ID [when client == null]; Selected client '{client.Name}' is not a Dealer/Sub-dealer [when visit.MetPersonType == "Dealer/ Sub-dealer" && client.Client_type?.type_name != "Dealer/ S]; IB leads can only be created when the visit contact is a client/influencer. [when visit.MetPersonType == "Dealer" || visit.MetPersonType == "Project" || client == null || c]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token [when currentUser == null]; Invalid token [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create visit
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Create visit — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IVisit.GetVisitActivityTypeByIdAsync, IVisit.GetVisitDealerByIdAsync
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; request body of type VisitPostDto; passes 6 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.validations: Invalid Visit Activity Type ID; Invalid Dealer ID; Invalid Project ID; Invalid Client ID; Selected client '{client.Name}' is not a Dealer/Sub-dealer; IB leads can only be created when the visit contact is a client/influencer.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Selected client '{client.Name}' is not a Dealer/Sub-dealer
IB leads can only be created when the visit contact is a client/influencer.

endpoints.name: Update Visit

idempotency.notes: Re-sending the same payload sets the same values

endpoints.detailed_description: Update visit. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IVisit.GetCrmVisitById, IVisit.GetVisitActivityTypeByIdAsync. Persists changes to: CRM_Visit: UPDATE. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid Visit Activity Type ID [when activityType == null]; Invalid Dealer ID [when dealer == null]; Invalid Client ID [when client == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to update visit
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Update visit — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IVisit.GetCrmVisitById, IVisit.GetVisitActivityTypeByIdAsync
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); request body of type VisitPostDto; passes 4 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: CRM_Visit: UPDATE; sets existingVisit.visit_activity_type, existingVisit.met_person_type, existingVisit.meeting_date, existingVisit.dealer, existingVisit.client, existingVisit.next_meeting_date and saves changes
business_logic.validations: Invalid Visit Activity Type ID; Invalid Dealer ID; Invalid Client ID
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)
